title_candidates: OpenAI Academy adds three work-focused AI courses
summary: OpenAI added Academy courses for AI basics, repeatable workflows, and agent-assisted work. The useful test is whether one course improves a real recurring task.

primary_source.title: New OpenAI Academy courses for the next era of work
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI introduced three Academy courses: AI Foundations, Applied AI Foundations, and Agents and Workflows.
The courses are meant to move learners from everyday prompting to repeatable workflows and then agent-assisted work.
OpenAI says learners can receive completion certificates, and organizations can use the courses for onboarding or adoption programs.

prerequisites: An OpenAI Academy account or willingness to sign in

steps.instruction: Open OpenAI Academy and sign in or join if prompted.
Open the Courses section and choose the course that matches your level: AI Foundations, Applied AI Foundations, or Agents and Workflows.
Pick one recurring task you actually do, such as meeting notes, weekly planning, or customer-response drafting.
Complete the first lesson or module, then write down one workflow rule you can reuse next time.
Try that rule on the real task once and keep it only if it saves time without lowering quality.
